title: Grilled Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: Rich and chewy Uruguayan beef skewers with cranberry, perfect for a solo dinner, cooked to perfection in a bamboo steamer
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika
Add the beef strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the marinated beef strips onto the bamboo skewers
Grill the skewers for 10 minutes, turning occasionally
Brush the skewers with cranberry sauce during the last 2 minutes of grilling
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional cranberry sauce if desired
Cook the skewers in a bamboo steamer for an additional 5 minutes to achieve tender and juicy beef
